purpose: Independent practice of B2.5 (multiplication with groups of 1/2 and 1/4). Captures formative evidence on fractional-group building.
student_learning_goal: I can show 4 groups of one half = 2 wholes, and 6 groups of one fourth = 1½, using drawings.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can show 4 groups of one half = 2 wholes, and 6 groups of one fourth = 1½, using drawings.
header.character_watermark: Mae the Multiplier in the top-right corner with her workshop apron. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Each scene shows N plates with one half-cookie each. Write the multiplication equation N × 1/2 = ___ wholes.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Four half-group scenes in a 2x2 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Four half-group scenes in B&W line-art, 2-row × 2-column grid. Each scene ~3in × 1.8in. Pre-fills: H1 — 4 plates with half-cookies (4 × 1/2 = 2); H2 — 6 plates with half-cookies (6 × 1/2 = 3); H3 — 8 plates with half-cookies (8 × 1/2 = 4); H4 — 5 plates with half-cookies (5 × 1/2 = 2½). Each plate ~1.2in diameter with one half-cookie shown (cookie cut along visible half-line).
image_placeholders.placement: Top of the page; four scenes in 2x2 grid.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_FOUR_HALVES: keywords (plates, half) name what the scenes show.

parts.answer_key: H1: 4 × 1/2 = 2 wholes. H2: 6 × 1/2 = 3 wholes. H3: 8 × 1/2 = 4 wholes. H4: 5 × 1/2 = 2½ wholes.

parts.student_instructions: Each scene shows N plates with one fourth-cookie each. Write the multiplication equation N × 1/4 = ___ wholes.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Four fourth-group scenes in a 2x2 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Four fourth-group scenes in B&W line-art, 2-row × 2-column grid. Each scene ~3in × 1.8in. Pre-fills: F1 — 4 plates with fourth-cookies (4 × 1/4 = 1); F2 — 6 plates with fourth-cookies (6 × 1/4 = 1½); F3 — 8 plates with fourth-cookies (8 × 1/4 = 2); F4 — 12 plates with fourth-cookies (12 × 1/4 = 3). Each plate has one fourth-cookie shown (cookie cut along visible fourth-lines).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_FOUR_FOURTHS: keywords (plates, fourth) name what the scenes show.

parts.answer_key: F1: 4 × 1/4 = 1 whole. F2: 6 × 1/4 = 1½ wholes. F3: 8 × 1/4 = 2 wholes. F4: 12 × 1/4 = 3 wholes.

parts.student_instructions: For each problem, draw the build with halves or fourths on plates.

image_placeholders.description: Three blank rectangular drawing boxes in B&W line-art, stacked vertically, each ~7in × 1.5in with light-grey solid outline. Above each box, a problem: 6 × 1/2, 8 × 1/4, 5 × 1/2. The child draws plates with half- or fourth-cookies.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_THREE_BUILDS: keywords (build, halves) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.answer_key: 6 × 1/2: 6 plates with one half each = 3 wholes. 8 × 1/4: 8 plates with one fourth each = 2 wholes. 5 × 1/2: 5 plates with one half each = 2½ wholes.

parts.student_instructions: Where do we use HALF groups in real life? Draw and write 1-2 examples.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. A blank box for real-life examples.

image_placeholders.description: A blank rectangular drawing box in B&W line-art, ~7in × 2in, with light-grey solid outline. Mae thinking-bubble icon in the top-right corner.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P4_REAL_LIFE_BOX: keywords (real-life) name what the box is for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any plausible half-group example: 'recipes — half cup of flour for each cookie batch', 'sharing snacks — half a granola bar each', 'pizza slices — half-pepperoni and half-cheese'.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write THREE more half- or fourth-group problems on the back and solve them.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Hand out at the end of the Action phase. Use Part 1 H4 (5 × 1/2) and Part 2 F2 (6 × 1/4) as the strongest evidence — children who get the half-leftover answers are at L4. Watch for: children who compute 4 × 1/2 = 8 (treating 1/2 as 2) — flag for the half-as-fraction reteach using pre-cut cookies.
